issues: 列表行和顶栏全是灰色骨架块，停点行没有内容，咬合锁定的是一条空白
滚动模糊是各向同性 blur，封顶 24px 时整屏糊成一片灰雾
角标是细细的墨色小角，咬合那一下没有分量，和急刹的“哐”撑不起共振
锁定后停点行只多一圈细描边，选中态和其余行几乎没有对比
changes: 换 sand 暖沙亮场：一份「Wren / Release notes」奶白卡长卷，56px 粗黑版本号 + 标题 + 说明 + 日期，停点 5.0「Inbox Autopilot」
滚动保留三段（sin-in 冲刺 → cubic-out 冲过头 34px → 6f 回弹），模糊改为按速度的纵向方向性模糊，色带有方向感
角标换成 10px 粗、84px 长的赤陶圆头 L 角，back(2.4) 飞入咬合，超调越过咬合位只往里“咬”12%，读作相机对焦框“咔”地锁住
组合命门严格同帧（f58）：急刹 = 角标起跳 = 1.6% 冲击推（单次 impact，非抖动）
被锁卡 6f 内由奶白翻成墨色（反白是最强的选中），右侧「Today」原地换成 back(2.6) 弹出的 NOW SHIPPING 页签，其余卡退暗 0.38 + 轻虚化
hold 段角标 ±1.5px 极缓呼吸、整幅 1.5% 推近，结尾帧干净落定
issuesEn: List rows and the top bar are grey skeleton blocks; the reticle locks onto an empty row
Scroll blur is isotropic and caps at 24px, so the whole frame turns into grey fog
The corner marks are thin dark ticks with no weight, too weak to resonate with the brake impact
After the lock the stop row only gains a thin outline and barely contrasts with the rest
changesEn: Sand warm light stage: a 'Wren / Release notes' scroll of cream cards with 56px heavy version numbers, title, description and date; the stop is 5.0 'Inbox Autopilot'
The three-phase scroll is kept (sin-in sprint, cubic-out overshoot of 34px, 6f settle) with velocity-driven vertical directional blur instead of fog
Corners become 10px-thick, 84px terracotta round-cap L brackets flying in with back(2.4); the overshoot past the lock point is scaled to 12% so it bites like an autofocus frame
The combo beat is strictly same-frame (f58): brake = bracket launch = a single 1.6% impact push (not shake)
The locked card inverts from cream to ink within 6f; its 'Today' swaps in place to a back(2.6) NOW SHIPPING tab; other cards dim to 0.38 and soften
The hold breathes the brackets by ±1.5px with a 1.5% slow push for a clean final frame
